code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is also mild erythrocytosis, increased RDW, and abnormal white cell differential (low neutrophil and lymphocyte %, high monocyte and basophil counts). Coagulation is altered (high INR, low PT). Findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible hypoxic respiratory failure, and risk of coagulopathy; urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
